 What’s closed for Veterans Day on Nov. 11 in LA County 
 Find out what government offices and other services are closed or have a regular schedule on Nov. 11, 2026

 By Holly Andres | handres@scng.com PUBLISHED: November 5, 2026 at 1:29 PM PST | UPDATED: November 5, 2026 at 1:51 PM PST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...  
 Khloie Ramirez and Rachel Fox write letters of appreciation for our troops during the annual Veterans Day Event at the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library in Simi Valley, Tuesday, Nov. 11, 2025. (Photo by Andy Holzman, Contributing Photographer) 
 Government offices — Los Angeles city and county, national and state offices — and superior courts, libraries and schools — are normally closed for a federal holiday.
 Los Angeles Unified School District schools are closed on Wednesday, Nov. 11 ( lausd.org and achieve.lausd.net/calendar ). For other Los Angeles County school districts, check your local district’s instructional 2026-2027 calendar for holidays.
 Here is a sampling of other services that may have altered schedules on Wednesday, Nov. 11:
 Banks: Closed ( federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm ).
 Libraries: Los Angeles Public Library locations are closed. facebook.com/lapubliclibrary and lapl.org/holiday-closures 
 Los Angeles County Library locations are closed. facebook.com/LACountyLibrary and lacountylibrary.org 
 Mail: The U.S. Postal Service does not deliver regular mail, and post offices are closed ( usps.com ). Holidays in 2026: about.usps.com/newsroom/events 
 Transit: Buses and rail services in Los Angeles run on a regular schedule ( metro.net ). For future holidays: click on Metro Maps and Schedules, choose the line route you want and then check the Saturday, Sunday and Holidays schedule section ( metro.net/riding/schedules-2/ ).
 Metrolink trains run on a regular schedule ( metrolinktrains.com ).
 Trash:  Pickup is on a regular schedule for city of Los Angeles Sanitation customers. Holiday Collection Delays: sanitation.lacity.gov . . facebook.com/lacitysan . In addition, see the LA Sanitation 2026 Service Calendar (it’s printable): tinyurl.com/35m5c99e 
 For other cities in Los Angeles County, consult your local company for trash pickup.
